severity_note: Prescribing labels support the effects and monitoring statements, not the project's Mild/Moderate/Severe scale. Existing ratings remain unvalidated dataset labels. New label-only matches are ungraded.

rules.basis: Acarbose label warning for thiazides and other diuretics; explicit mapping to the two supported diuretics.
rules.description: The diuretic may raise blood glucose and reduce blood-glucose control during acarbose treatment.
rules.recommendation: The prescriber should monitor blood glucose when the diuretic is started or stopped and review diabetes treatment if control changes.

rules.basis: Prescribing-label NSAID class warning mapped only to the four supported NSAIDs.
rules.description: Taking an NSAID with methotrexate can increase methotrexate toxicity, including reduced white blood cells or platelets and impaired kidney function. Risk depends on the treatment and patient factors.
rules.recommendation: The prescriber should monitor for methotrexate toxicity during combined treatment, including blood counts and kidney function as clinically appropriate.

rules.basis: NSAID class warning with ACE inhibitors or ARBs; explicit membership mapping, not partial-name matching.
rules.description: The NSAID may reduce the blood-pressure-lowering effect of the other medicine. Kidney function can worsen, especially in older people, people with dehydration, or people with existing kidney impairment.
rules.recommendation: The prescriber should review blood pressure and kidney function during combined treatment, particularly in patients with these risk factors.

sources.title: DailyMed: Diclofenac — ACE inhibitors and ARBs

rules.basis: Clonidine warning for concomitant beta-blocker therapy, mapped to the two supported beta-blockers.
rules.description: Beta-blocker treatment can increase the risk of a marked rise in blood pressure if clonidine is stopped abruptly. This warning depends on withdrawal of clonidine, not simply taking a dose of both medicines.
rules.recommendation: Do not stop clonidine abruptly. A prescriber should plan and supervise any change to this combination.

rules.basis: Named combination in the telmisartan prescribing label.
rules.review_note: The legacy dataset labels this pair Mild, but the label advises avoiding combined renin-angiotensin-system blockade. Clinical review of the dataset rating is required.
rules.description: Combined treatment can increase low blood pressure, high potassium, and kidney dysfunction. The label reports more kidney dysfunction without added benefit for this combination in the ONTARGET population.
rules.recommendation: The label advises generally avoiding combined renin-angiotensin-system blockade. The prescriber should review the combination and monitor blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolytes when used.

sources.title: DailyMed: Telmisartan — Dual blockade of the RAS

rules.basis: Named concomitant methotrexate risk in the leflunomide label.
rules.description: Combined treatment increases concern for liver toxicity and bone marrow suppression, which can reduce blood-cell counts.
rules.recommendation: The prescriber should monitor liver tests and blood-cell counts during combined treatment.

sources.title: DailyMed: Leflunomide — Liver and bone marrow warnings

rules.basis: Combination evidence in the delayed-release sulfasalazine label for rheumatoid arthritis.
rules.description: In rheumatoid arthritis studies, the combination produced more gastrointestinal adverse effects, particularly nausea, than either medicine alone.
rules.recommendation: Discuss persistent nausea or other gastrointestinal symptoms with the prescriber so treatment tolerance can be reviewed.
